title: Running-app guard: match the mac install path case-insensitively
notes: APFS is case-insensitive by default, so rm -rf /applications/dashboard.app deletes the installed build, and stopsRunningApp lets it through. INSTALLED in src/main/workflow/running-app-guard.ts has no /i flag (RUNNING_APP does). Fix: match the /Applications/Dashboard.app alternative case-insensitively and add the lowercase command to the refused list in running-app-guard.test.ts. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/326 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/325#discussion_r4612938925

comments.body: From main, 2026-11-26: INSTALLED in running-app-guard.ts:56 puts anyCase() on the Windows parts but leaves /Applications/Dashboard.app case-sensitive; tests use only the capitalised path.
Pull request #390 opened: Running-app guard: match the mac install path in any case https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/390
